Happy Birthday, Barnali

a little birthday film

every photo is really you — I just couldn't get you to actually sing, so I let the pictures do it instead. press play 🎂

Riye, twenty-four looks so good on you. Somewhere between the misty pine forests, the fog-wrapped hills, and every quiet evening you've lit up without even trying, you became the best part of my everyday.

You carry warmth like sunlight through the trees — the kind that turns ordinary places into memories worth keeping. I hope this year hands you every wish you're too shy to say out loud, and a few you haven't even thought of yet.

So happy birthday, Palu ji. Here's to more roads, more skylines, more silly photos, and every "us" still waiting ahead.

— always yours
